LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.continuous_entrop: On a fixed finite alphabet, entropy is a continuous function of the probability law.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.continuous_condEn: On a fixed pair of finite alphabets, the conditional entropy H(X | Y) is a continuous function of the joint law of X and Y.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.continuous_mutual: On a fixed pair of finite alphabets, mutual information is a continuous function of the joint law.
For a fixed channel W between finite alphabets, the mutual information between its input and its output is a continuous function of the input law.
